newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ONE HOUR STRIKE RESPONSE PATCHY IN S.AFRICA'S CAPE.
newsitem.headline: ONE HOUR STRIKE RESPONSE PATCHY IN S.AFRICA'S CAPE.

text.p: A call for a one-hour work stoppage by the Congress of South African Trade Unions met with a patchy response in Cape Town on Monday, business groups and companies said.
"Industry has been affected more than commerce, but it has been very patchy," a spokesman for the Cape Chamber of Commerce and Industry told Reuters.
"It ranged from no response to a partial turn-out."
Caltex Oil (SA)(Pty) Ltd said that its Milnerton refinery had not been affected by the stoppage at all while the port and railways operated normally.
The stoppage had been called in protest against the Basic Conditions of Employment Bill, which is due to be tabled in parliament next month.
